notes.title: Thank You for Playing the ZPF Demo! 🚀
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest has been an incredible ride, and we couldn’t have done it without you! With [b]over 1,000 players trying out the ZPF demo[/b] and [b]1,265 wishlists[/b] during the event, your support has been overwhelming.

From day one to this point—before our official launch—you've been with us every step of the way. We truly appreciate every playthrough, wishlist, and piece of feedback.
Stay tuned for more thrilling updates as we prepare to launch into the cosmos. We can’t wait to share this adventure with you!

Feeling the excitement?  While you wait for the game to launch, check out this awesome soundtrack video in case you missed it:
[previewyoutube=CK3lSbT1cfo;full][/previewyoutube]
With all love and appreciation,
[b]The ZPF Team & Mega Cat Studios[/b]

notes.title: ZPF Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest + Development Update! 🚀
notes.content:
The wait is over—[url=https://megacatstudios.com/pages/zpf][i]ZPF[/i][/url]'s demo is officially live on Steam for Next Fest! Get ready to experience the ultimate 16-bit shoot-'em-up, blending horror, sci-fi, and fantasy into a fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled adventure.

🔥 What’s in the Demo?
✨ Pilot Knight, Gladius, or Gold—each with unique playstyles
🌍 Blast through three action-packed stages
👾 Face intense minibosses & massive screen-filling bosses
🎶 Immerse yourself in a pulse-pounding chiptune soundtrack

🔗 Download the demo now and test your skills!

💾 Don’t forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3095410/ZPF/][i]ZPF on Steam[/i][/url]! Wishlisting helps us gain more visibility and ensures you won’t miss any updates leading up to the launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109390/bec283f1fc7847ce9a98f0bf58c3eec14de3006b.png[/img]

[h3][b]🛠️ Development Update – From Mikael Tillander[/b][/h3]

As we charge forward with ZPF’s development, we wanted to share an update. The game is nearly complete, with the final graphics additions.

However, in testing different builds, the ZPF Team encountered an unexpected ROM size issue—somehow, between demo and final versions, an additional 100K mysteriously appeared! After carefully trimming excess graphics, the issue was resolved, but it’s a reminder of how unpredictable game development can be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109390/f06700763b74d202c199270844a151cf2dafa8ba.png[/img]
[i]Photo by Mike Dosik[/i]

Fulfillment has been [b]moved to May[/b] due to unexpected vendor delays, but we’re using this extra time to refine and polish the game to ensure the best possible experience. Thank you for your patience and support!

📸 See the dev update straight from Mikael Tillander!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109390/5ca231e27413d0ad97d78f9539034667e422c465.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🎶 Jamie Vance Developer Talk + Live Performance Now Out
[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109390/25dc0d0be4d97632fb9dab89fc2e1c4a0876e73e.png[/img]

We just released an exclusive developer talk featuring Jamie Vance! 🎧 He spills the beans on the development of ZPF’s official soundtrack, its inspirations, and the hurdles he’s overcome along the way. Plus, he delivers an electrifying live performance of some of the game’s standout tracks. Watch it now!

[previewyoutube=YiqKjw8C1EE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]🔎 Explore the World of ZPF![/b][/h3]

Still curious about the game's story and universe? We’ve also previously released an exclusive lore video narrated by Quibley that dives deep into the mysteries and forces at play in the ZPF universe. If you’ve wondered what awaits beyond the chaos, this is your must-watch guide!

ZPF Lore Trailer - Story Time With Quibley
[previewyoutube=ZBt2H8MUx5U;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re so close to the finish line—thank you for your support and patience as we bring this SHMUP to life! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109390/6eb3f154aa01d72ea76a9a97194b061517c0fe6a.png[/img]
[i]Photo by Mike Dosik
[/i]
With all love and appreciation,
[b]The ZPF Team & Mega Cat Studios[/b]
